comment: Worth mentioning here that a national HRHIS is a system of systems - it includes HWF registry, HRIS, LMS (covering the gamut of pre-service and continuing education), payroll, etc. It also involves diversification and triangulation with multiple data sources, such as Census, labour force surveys, etc. So in order to monitor the entire aspects of the health labour market, a health workforce registry in itself is not sufficient.

public.text: Worth mentioning here that a national HRHIS is a system of systems - it includes HWF registry, HRIS, LMS (covering the gamut of pre-service and continuing education), payroll, etc. It also involves diversification and triangulation with multiple data sources, such as Census, labour force surveys, etc. So in order to monitor the entire aspects of the health labour market, a health workforce registry in itself is not sufficient.
